name: AdminFly – Move Faster in WordPress
author: Pranav MT

sections.description:
WordPress and WooCommerce are powerful platforms, but their backend navigation can be frustratingly slow. Buried settings, endless clicks, and poor optimization waste valuable time for developers and store owners alike.

AdminFly changes everything ⚡.

With a sleek admin bar menu, intelligent search, and instant access to every corner of your WordPress admin, AdminFly transforms how you work. No more hunting through nested menus or waiting for pages to load. Navigate WordPress like never before.

Live Demo

Key Features:

  • ⚡ Instant access to WooCommerce and WordPress admin screens
  • 🚀 Optimization Engine: Dark Mode, Nag Shield, Performance Tweaks, and more
  • 🔍 Powerful search modal for Products, Orders, Posts, Pages, and Users
  • 🕘 Recent history tracking for faster admin navigation
  • 🔗 Automatically discovers settings links for active plugins
  • 🎛️ Customizable menus with new tab or same tab preference
  • 🪶 Lightweight, performance-optimized, and secure

🚀 More features coming to make the WordPress admin even faster:

  • ⌨️ Command-palette style quick actions
  • 🧠 Keyboard shortcuts for power users
  • ⭐ Smart favorites and pinned admin pages
  • ⚙️ Faster, optimized admin workflows

Usage

  1. Visit Tools → AdminFly to open settings
  2. Toggle the menu branches you want (WooCommerce, Products, Orders, Plugins, Themes, Posts, Pages, Users, Settings, Recent History)
  3. Choose your link target preference (New Tab or Same Tab)
  4. Click Scan Plugin Settings to discover settings links for your active plugins
  5. Click the AdminFly icon in the admin bar to access all your shortcuts
  6. Use Find Product, Find Order, etc. to search and jump directly to edit screens
  7. Check Recent to see your recently visited admin pages
  8. Use the Optimise Admin tab to enable Dark Mode, remove bloat, and speed up your dashboard

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact the author.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the adminfly-fast-navigator folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to Tools → AdminFly to customize your settings
  4. AdminFly appears in the admin bar immediately after activation
sections.faq:
Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes. AdminFly gracefully hides WooCommerce-specific links when WooCommerce is not active. All WordPress core features work independently.

Can I customize which links show?

Absolutely. Go to Tools → AdminFly and enable/disable any menu branch. Your preferences are saved automatically.

How does the search feature work?

Click any “Find…” menu item (like “Find Product” or “Find Order”). A beautiful modal appears where you can search by ID, name, or email. Results open instantly in your preferred tab.

What is Recent History?

AdminFly tracks the admin pages you visit and displays them in the Recent menu for quick access. This is stored per-user in the database.

Is it resource intensive?

No. AdminFly is intentionally lightweight and optimized for performance. It adds minimal overhead to your WordPress admin.

Can I see plugin settings in the menu?

Yes! Use the “Scan Plugin Settings” button in AdminFly settings. It will discover and cache settings links for all your active plugins.
